### Description
A clear and concise description of what design work or asset update is needed (e.g. dark mode assets, vector icons, banners).

### Proposed Solution
1. Asset specifications (dimensions, transparent background, naming convention).
2. Integration details (affected files like `assets/icons/` or `data.json`).

### Affected Files
- `assets/icons/`
- `src/json/data.json`

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Asset matches Google Developer Groups brand guidelines.
- [ ] Tested for high contrast on relevant themes (Classic / Dark / Pixel).
- [ ] Assets are compressed and optimized.
